# wimyip.net

> wimyip.net is a free, publicly searchable archive of Internet
> infrastructure data: IP addresses, ASNs (Autonomous Systems), IP
> prefixes/CIDR blocks, domains, and nameservers, with historical WHOIS
> ownership records, BGP announcement history, PeeringDB profiles, DNS
> record history (A/AAAA/NS/MX/TXT), and PTR (reverse DNS) records.

The site is a client-rendered web app, but pages under the paths below
are served as fully rendered, self-contained HTML (no JavaScript
required) to crawlers and automated clients, so their content can be
read directly.

## Content

- IP address lookup (ASN, announced prefix, PTR record, BGP history): `/ip/{ip}`
- Autonomous System (ASN) lookup (org info, peering, announced prefixes, WHOIS history): `/asn/{asn}`
- IP prefix / CIDR lookup (RIR allocation, WHOIS ownership history): `/prefix/{cidr}`
- Domain lookup (DNS record history, WHOIS-adjacent metadata): `/domain/{domain}`
- Nameserver lookup (IP history, domains it serves): `/nameserver/{nameserver}`

## Notes

- Data is sourced from public RIR/RDAP registries, RIPEstat BGP data,
  PeeringDB, Certificate Transparency logs, and active DNS/PTR
  resolution — not from any private or paywalled source.
- robots.txt: https://wimyip.net/robots.txt
- sitemap.xml: https://wimyip.net/sitemap.xml
